mode.title: Scraping Mode
mode.description: Specifies whether to scrape products, monitor products, or scrape reviews. Products monitoring mode accepts direct product URLs only.

country.title: 🌍 Country
country.description: The Adidas website country to scrape (e.g. 'United States' will scrape products from https://www.adidas.com/us).

searchUrls.title: Search URLs
searchUrls.description: The search URLs from which to scrape products.

productUrls.title: Product URLs
productUrls.description: The URLs for specific products to scrape.

maxProducts.title: Maximum Products
maxProducts.description: The maximum total number of products to be scraped. Use 0 for unlimited.

maxProductsPerSearch.title: Maximum Products
maxProductsPerSearch.description: The maximum number of products to be scraped PER SEARCH. Use 0 for unlimited.

maxReviews.title: Maximum Reviews
maxReviews.description: The maximum total number of reviews to scrape (for reviews mode only). Use 0 for unlimited.

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Maximum Reviews Per Product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: The maximum number of reviews to scrape PER PRODUCT (for reviews mode only). Use 0 to scrape all available reviews for each product.

reviewsSort.title: Reviews Sort
reviewsSort.description: Specifies how to sort product reviews for each product.

scrapeReviewsFromAllLanguages.title: Scrape Reviews from All Languages
scrapeReviewsFromAllLanguages.description: Scrape reviews from all languages instead of restricting to the selected country website. Note: The total number of scraped reviews may be significantly higher than the product's reviewCount you see in the products mode, as reviewCount reflects current country website metrics only.
